audit.whatIsWrong: The page called this HARD at 8/10 with a Cassiopeia carry threat of 8.5/10, while the win rate is 51.91% over 1177 games and the packet chart plus the entire content layer say Katarina wins all seven stages.
audit.why: Miasma's grounding is a real anti-Katarina mechanic, but it is 24s at rank 1 against a 12s Shunpo, and Cassiopeia has no dash, no shield and a conditional ultimate. A 51.91% lane is not an 8/10. The difficulty label was the only thing arguing for HARD, and it contradicted every other field on the page.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 5.5/10, carryRating 7/10, tone to the amber token, with breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t moved to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven phases[N].side read Cassiopeia while all seven phases[N].why described Katarina winning that stage, and the content layer's win[0..6] read Katarina on every row. The row and the sentence under it said opposite things.
audit.why: This is the exact side-without-why defect the chart rule exists to stop. The packet chart and content layer agree on Katarina, and the kit supports it: Level 3 Shunpo punishes every Noxious Blast, Level 6 Death Lotus beats a Petrifying Gaze that only stuns what faces it, and her scaling only takes over in an extended fight you do not have to give her.
audit.corrected: phases[0..6].side -> Katarina. Ratings for the last three rows lowered (6/10, 6/10, 5/10) so the chart shows the margin thinning into her item spikes rather than reading flat. win[0..6] already holds Katarina on disk, so no content-layer chart edit is needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no number in it. dosFull[1].d was tradeGood pasted under 'Bait his CC', dontsFull[2].d was tradeBad pasted under 'All-in into spell-shield kits' — Cassiopeia has no spell shield. Four fields called her 'his'.
audit.why: The two interactions that decide this matchup are both in the kits and neither was stated with numbers: Miasma grounds, and grounded means Shunpo's second cast does not exist, on a 24/22/20/18/16 cooldown; Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing her, which is the difference between Death Lotus resolving and Death Lotus being cancelled by hard CC (Katarina's R is flagged channel-interruptible). Twin Fang at a 0.75s cooldown is why any stand-still fight inside her poison is lost.
audit.corrected: Real numbers in breakdown.cooldowns; the grounding and facing rules stated in dontsFull[2].d, dosFull[2].d and tradeBad; every 'his' changed to 'her'.

audit.why: Miasma is the punishable cooldown at 24s rank 1 dropping to 16s; Noxious Blast at 3.5s is never a window, which is why the field must say which cooldown actually gates you.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with W, R and Q numbers and an explicit statement that only W and R gate your step-up.

audit.why: 51.91% over 1177 games is the figure in the data and no elo tier is written anywhere in the new text.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.wave used the placeholder 'a CC mage's tower'.
audit.why: The real wave trap is a freeze near her tower where a single Miasma lands on the dagger you have to walk onto.
audit.corrected: Rewritten around her mana cost to hold a wave and the Miasma-on-your-dagger trap.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer's 'late' field wrote 'three Twin Fangs' — the ability is Twin Fang, singular (packet suspectNames, distance 1). Separately, dosFull[0].t said 'Trade through grounded daggers only', implying Katarina grounds; her Q's grounding derived flag contradicts Riot's description, which is only a bounce and a ricochet.
audit.why: A pluralised ability name reads as a fabrication to anyone who knows the champion, and the grounding claim would teach a reader Katarina can deny Miasma. She cannot — the grounding in this matchup runs one way only.
audit.corrected: 'three Twin Fangs land' -> 'three Twin Fang hits land'; dosFull[0].t -> 'Trade only through landed daggers'.
